name: oas4_h3_retrieval
endpoint: Framework-averaged native edit similarity; length, diversity, conditional recovery and judge scores are supporting.
limits: Reference arms, not generators: they sample training H3 loops whose flanks share a key with the framework. The key of `retrieval` (last 12 residues of FR3 plus first 6 of FR4) is the primary, fixed before the variants were scored; `retrieval_j` and `retrieval_fine` are sensitivity checks outside the planned contrast family.
Only the training split is searched, using the flank strings alone; no native, length, partner chain or antigen information is read.
A framework whose key never occurs in training uses the unconditional training pool; each record states which pool it used.
Validation demonstration; no final test estimate.
